body:
**Eicher Motors (Royal Enfield)**
- Siddhartha Lal joined and became Royal Enfield CEO around 2000. The brand was "barely trudging along" with stagnant sales before the product reboot (repositioned controls, more powerful models) — [Business Standard](https://business-standard.com/amp/article/companies/ceo-of-the-year-racing-ahead-117031700863_1.html); [Medium/Finception](https://medium.com/finception/eicher-motors-from-good-to-great-69bab6ca47a2)
- Eicher was the Fastest Wealth Creator in Motilal Oswal's 19th study (2009–14). Eicher, Supreme Industries and Page Industries were in the top 10 fastest — [MOSL WC study 2009-14](https://www.motilaloswal.com/content/dam/mofsl-website-adobe/investor-relations/wealth-creation/wc19.pdf)
- From April 2005 at about ₹32 adjusted to about ₹2,754, an 86x gain, by the time of PrimeInvestor's article — [PrimeInvestor, "A multi-bagger that no one foresaw"](https://primeinvestor.in/?p=56537). Recent price about ₹7,630 (7 Sep 2026; 52-week range ₹6,411–8,230) — [Kotak Neo](https://www.kotakneo.com/stocks/eicher-motors-ltd/). Note: the pre-2020 price (around ₹27,000–30,000) was before the 2020 10:1 split, so "₹30,000" is the unadjusted peak-era price.

**Defence PSUs (HAL, BEL, Mazagon Dock, Cochin Shipyard)**
- July 2023: the rally in defence stocks was "largely driven by valuation rerating rather than faster growth in revenue and profit" — [Business Standard](https://www.business-standard.com/markets/news/rally-in-listed-defence-stocks-yet-to-be-backed-by-earnings-growth-123071300913_1.html)
- Elara linked the rerating to the rising share of indigenisation and to export opportunities — [Business Standard May 2024](https://www.business-standard.com/markets/news/defense-stocks-on-roll-bdl-bel-hal-cochin-shipyard-rally-5-124051800383_1.html)
- April 2025 multiples versus history: HAL 28.4x one-year-forward P/E against a 5-year average of 14x. BEL 40.8x against 20.7x. Mazagon Dock 29.7x against a 3-year average of 16.6x — [Business Today/Nirmal Bang](https://businesstoday.in/markets/stocks/story/mazagon-dock-hal-bdl-bel-share-price-targets-for-9-defence-stocks-ahead-of-q4-results-471974-2025-04-15). Multiples roughly doubled against history.

body: The core ingredients (cross-sectional momentum, time-series momentum/trend following, the 52-week-high effect, and post-earnings-announcement drift) are among the most robust anomalies in finance, including in India. Chart patterns and indicator rules have much weaker, era- and data-snooping-sensitive evidence. Meanwhile, base rates for active retail traders are grim: ~88-93% of Indian F&O traders lose money each year, 97% of persistent Brazilian day traders lost money, and <1% of Taiwanese day traders are predictably profitable.
